question: Should OpenClaw accept the new `gateway.reload.autoRestartOnRequired` config key and the changed hot-mode `config.patch`/`config.apply` restart semantics?
rationale: The PR intentionally adds config surface and changes upgrade-sensitive gateway restart behavior, which repo policy treats as maintainer product/compatibility intent rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept the split contract
options.body: Keep default hot-mode warn-and-keep for routine edits, always restart for auth/profile/provider-secret changes, and let operators opt routine restart-required edits into supervised restart.

options.title: Keep RPC direct restart
options.body: Preserve current hot-mode RPC direct-restart behavior if explicit config writes are intended to remain stronger than file-watcher hot mode.

options.title: Reject the new config key
options.body: Redesign around existing modes, explicit writer intent, or diagnostics without adding another gateway reload option.

recommendation.title: Accept the split contract
recommendation.body: Keep default hot-mode warn-and-keep for routine edits, always restart for auth/profile/provider-secret changes, and let operators opt routine restart-required edits into supervised restart.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway reload history and current-line provenance make this the best available routing candidate, though broader gateway owners may need to approve the product contract.
